content: {"episode_id":"ep-05224","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the CO-197 denial for CPT 93247, which was denied because required prior authorization was not obtained. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and exertional chest tightness, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmia in the context of established atherosclerotic heart disease. Long-term continuous ECG monitoring was ordered to characterize the frequency and morphology of these events and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances."}
